name: Hotel Sonnenhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Sonnenhof is quietly located in the Kaunertal and offers a good base for activities in the region. The hotel is run in a traditional alpine style, which shapes the atmosphere of the entire stay. Typical amenities include a breakfast buffet, half board, and a wellness area with sauna. The restaurant serves mainly regional specialties of Tirol. In winter, guests can easily reach the Skigebiet Kaunertaler Gletscher via the hotel's own ski bus. In summer, numerous hiking and mountain biking trails are available. The rooms are comfortably furnished, and many of them offer a balcony with mountain views. Guests can enjoy a quiet and relaxing holiday here in the mountains of Tirol.
